name: Albaladejo del Cuende (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red with a yellow triangle issuing from the hoist, charged in the upper fly with the crowned municipal arms of Albaladejo del Cuende (a bridge and a town above waves on red).
history: Municipal flag of Albaladejo del Cuende; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
Albaladejo del Cuende arms — bridge and town above waves
